title: GLExportDispatched
description: An ERP export batch was authorised and dispatched: one attempt (LED-23). Emitted in the transaction that recorded the attempt, through the transactional outbox. Dispatched is not received and not posted: the ERP's receipt and posting are recorded separately, with the ERP's references. Every attempt of a batch carries the same externalRef and batchDigest, and a connector must send it under that reference so the ERP posts one GL journal however many attempts there are. Thin: no amount; read the batch's lines from GET /v1/erp-bridges/{bridgeId}/exports/{batchId}.
$comment: Producer: backend/internal/app/erp.go (emitDispatch). Event type com.zoikotax.gl.export-dispatched; schema ref ztax:events/gl-export-dispatched/1.0.0. Partition key erp-export/<batchId>, so a batch's attempts arrive in order.
